title: They work but aren't pretty up close
text: They work but aren't pretty up close. I bought these for my day of the dead alter in my house because I couldn't find any live flowers to use. There are a lot in the packaging, which is nice. You do need to take them out of the bag and let them kind of fluff up for a while afterwards, and then there are a couple you need to do by hand. They look pretty decent from a distance, but if you get up close they do look pretty cheap. I think I would recommend these only depending on your needs, like if people are going to be really up close then I would probably take a pass, but if not then these will probably work for you.
